Definition
[Orbifold fibration] 1. 13.4.1\group fibrations Source: thurston:page-0336

A fibration over an orbifold $O$ with generic fiber $F$ is locally a quotient $(F\times \widetilde U)/\Gamma $, where the finite chart group acts on the base and through structure-group automorphisms on $F$.
Proof

\sketch Local products descend under the diagonal chart action, and changes of orbifold charts induce the required structure-group transitions.

□
